item.title: She Was Found Dead In Her School Bathroom
item.description: Thirteen-year-old Ta'ir Rada was found murdered inside her school's bathroom in Israel in 2006. The investigation led to a controversial conviction, years of appeals, disputed forensic evidence, and intense public debate, making it one of the country's most divisive and closely followed criminal cases.

item.title: The Strange Disappearance That Still Has No Answers
item.description: Twelve-year-old Johnny Gosch vanished while delivering newspapers in Iowa in 1982, becoming one of America's most infamous missing child cases. Decades later, conflicting witness accounts, conspiracy theories, and unanswered questions continue to fuel one of the most mysterious disappearances in true crime history.
